moments.cue: A 175‑pound black bear died after eating 75 pounds of cocaine dropped from a smuggler’s plane.
Drug smugglers Andrew Thornton and Bill Leonard were flying a Cessna 404 Titan over Knoxville.
To lighten their load, they jettisoned 40 cocaine containers, which fell to the forest below.
The bear stumbled upon the packages, ingested about 75 pounds of cocaine, and overdosed.
Later, her body was taxidermied and placed on display in a Kentucky shopping mall.
